title: NCAA: Injured Mangubat unfazed by bigger burden for undermanned JRU
summary: Still dealing with a right shoulder injury, Lawrence Mangubat is set to shoulder a heavier load as an undermanned Jose Rizal University continues its title pursuit in NCAA Season 102.
